section.content: 本实用新型涉及医用器械领域，具体涉及一种生物基因快速取样器，包括壳体、顶杆和取样冠，所述取样冠固定连接顶杆外侧，所述顶杆内侧端设置有插槽，所述壳体外侧端连接有保护帽，所述壳体滑动收纳连接有安装块，所述顶杆通过内侧端的插槽活动插接安装块外侧端，所述壳体和安装块均横向转动贯穿连接有转轴，所述转轴两侧端均连接有转盘。本实用新型通过调节机构对安装块以及取样冠收纳连接与壳体内，配合保护帽螺纹连接壳体对取样冠进行保护，防止外界细菌或灰尘落入，影响采用的准确性，另外设置有驱动结构实现取样冠取样时往返运动在口腔取样，提升整体的取样效率，其整体结构设置合理，操作简单便携，实用性更佳。

Biological gene rapid samplerTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the field of medical equipment, concretely relates to biological gene rapid sampler.

Background

A gene is the entire nucleotide sequence required to produce a polypeptide chain or functional RNA. Genes support the basic architecture and performance of life. All information of the processes of race, blood type, inoculation, growth, apoptosis and the like of life is stored. The mutual dependence of environment and heredity deduces important physiological processes of life such as reproduction, cell division, protein synthesis and the like. All life phenomena of living body such as growth, aging, disease, aging and death are related to genes. It is also an intrinsic factor in determining life health.

Based on the importance of genes, the genes are sampled and detected in the existing medical examination and research. For example, chinese patent with application number CN201621061293.5 discloses a gene detection sampler, including sleeve and ejector pin, the sleeve top is equipped with first recess, the sleeve bottom is equipped with the second recess, it has logical groove to run through between first recess and the second recess, it installs the ejector pin to lead to the inslot, ejector pin end connection has the sample to guan, the sample is covered and is held in first recess, the ejector pin other end is equipped with the trompil, it is equipped with the baffle to keep away from logical groove in the second recess, the baffle is kept away from and is equipped with the spring in ejector pin one side and the second recess, spring one end and second groove connection, the spring other end is connected with the slider, the slider interpolation is equipped with the connecting rod, the connecting rod runs through in the trompil.

However, in the existing detection mechanism, a sampling crown for detection cannot be protected, and external dust or bacteria are easily adhered to the sampling crown, so that the final detection effect is influenced; and the operation and use are inconvenient, and the whole practicability is poor. To the above problem, the utility model designs a biological gene rapid sampler.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

To the deficiency of the prior art, the utility model provides a biological gene rapid sampler solves the above-mentioned problem as far as possible.

The utility model discloses a following technical scheme realizes:

the utility model provides a biological gene rapid sampler, includes casing, ejector pin and sample hat, the sample hat fixed connection ejector pin outside, ejector pin medial extremity is provided with the slot, casing outside end is connected with the protective cap, casing slip is accomodate and is connected with the installation piece, the ejector pin passes through the slot activity grafting installation piece outside end of medial extremity, casing and installation piece all transversely rotate through connection have the pivot, pivot both sides end all is connected with the carousel.

Preferably, the surface of the outer side end of the shell is provided with a connecting thread, and the protective cap is in threaded fit with the connecting thread on the outer side of the shell.

Preferably, a friction pad is arranged at the outer side end of the mounting block, the friction pad is made of a rubber pad material, and the slot at the inner side end of the ejector rod is in friction contact with the friction pad.

Preferably, the outer side of the mounting block is connected with a slot communicated with the inner cavity in a penetrating manner, the rotating shaft movably penetrates through the slot, and the two side walls of the inner cavity of the mounting block are uniformly provided with clamping teeth.

Preferably, both sides of the rotating shaft are fixedly connected with the rotating discs through connecting blocks, a fluted disc is fixedly sleeved on the outer side of the rotating shaft, a half of the outer side of the fluted disc is provided with rotating teeth, and the rotating teeth and the clamping teeth are meshed with each other.

The utility model has the advantages that:

the utility model discloses an installation piece cooperation friction pad realizes simple dismantlement installation with the ejector pin that sample crown and sample crown are connected, and the change after the sample of being convenient for is used, accomodates the connection and the casing through adjustment mechanism to installation piece and sample crown, and cooperation protective cap threaded connection casing protects the sample crown, prevents that external bacterium or dust from falling into, influences the accuracy of adoption, and the back and forth movement is in the oral cavity sample when being provided with drive structure in addition and realizing the sample crown sample, promotes holistic sampling efficiency.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the embodiments of the present invention or the technical solutions in the prior art, the drawings used in the description of the embodiments or the prior art will be briefly described below, it is obvious that the drawings in the following description are only some embodiments of the present invention, and for those skilled in the art, other drawings can be obtained according to these drawings without creative efforts.

FIG. 1 is a schematic structural view of the present invention;

FIG. 2 is a partial cross-sectional view of the mounting block structure of FIG. 1 according to the present invention;

fig. 3 is a top view of the rotating shaft structure of fig. 1 according to the present invention.

In the figure: 1-shell, 11-connecting thread, 2-protective cap, 3-mounting block, 31-friction pad, 32-groove, 33-latch, 4-ejector rod, 5-sampling crown, 6-rotating shaft, 61-connecting block, 62-fluted disc and 7-rotating disc.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present invention clearer, the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are some, but not all, embodiments of the present invention. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative efforts belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1 to 3, a fast biological gene sampler comprises a housing 1, a top rod 4 and a sampling crown 5, wherein the sampling crown 5 is fixedly connected to the outer side of the top rod 4, a slot is formed at the inner side end of the top rod 4, the outer side end of the housing 1 is connected with a protective cap 2, the housing 1 is slidably accommodated and connected with an installation block 3, the top rod 4 is movably inserted into the outer side end of the installation block 3 through the slot at the inner side end, the housing 1 and the installation block 3 are transversely rotated and penetratingly connected with a rotating shaft 6, and both side ends of the rotating shaft 6.

Specifically, the surface of the outer side end of the housing 1 is provided with a connecting thread 11, and the protective cap 2 is in threaded fit with the connecting thread 11 on the outer side of the housing 1. The outer side end of the mounting block 3 is provided with a friction pad 31, the friction pad 31 is made of rubber pad material, and the slot at the inner side end of the push rod 4 is in friction contact with the friction pad 31. The outside of the mounting block 3 is connected with a slot 32 communicated with the inner cavity in a penetrating way, the rotating shaft 6 movably penetrates through the slot 32, and the two side walls of the inner cavity of the mounting block 3 are uniformly provided with clamping teeth 33. The two side ends of the rotating shaft 6 are fixedly connected with the rotating disc 7 through the connecting block 61, the toothed disc 62 is fixedly sleeved on the outer side of the middle of the rotating shaft 6, and a half of the outer side of the toothed disc 62 is provided with rotating teeth which are meshed with the clamping teeth 33.

The working principle is as follows: the utility model discloses during the use, thereby the protective cap 2 is taken off in the cooperation of the connecting thread 11 in the screw thread rotation protective cap 2 and the 1 outside of casing, it drives pivot 6 through connecting block 61 and rotates to rotate carousel 7, the fluted disc 62 that the fixed cover of 6 intermediate positions of pivot was established this moment rotates along with pivot 6, and the fluted disc 62 outside half of the commentaries on classics tooth that sets up and the latch 33 intermeshing of 3 inner wall both sides of installation piece, thereby final pivot 6's rotation has realized that installation piece 3 makes the back and forth movement in casing 1, and the fluting 32 and the 6 spout cooperations in the installation piece 3 outsides. With the sample 5 butt joint personnel's that await measuring oral cavity, rotate carousel 7 and drive sample 5 back and forth movements of crown through installation piece 3 and carry out the oral cavity sample, after the sample is accomplished, take off ejector pin 4 and sample crown 5 through medical tweezers and carry out medical analysis to rewrite the friction pad 31 of establishing the installation piece 3 outside end of sample crown 5 and ejector pin 4 friction cover that more renews, be convenient for sample the use next time.
